style: Premium minimal SaaS sonic-logo sting in light mode (Notion / Linear light register). Clean paper stage, ink-blue brand mark, one breathing motif, one satin glint. Reusable 4s intro for Physiofit product-launch and Academy videos.

palette.note: ink = official Physiofit BlueDark from the brand SVGs; tint/glint are derived halo tones

font: none — the wordmark is the official vector logotype

asset_needs.status: official Physiofit Wort-Bild-Marke supplied by the user; paths used 1:1 (Bildmarke head + foot, 9 letter paths)

reused.text-shimmer: specular band technique — a lighter-toned copy of the whole lockup revealed through one moving mask band (satin glint)
reused.grain-overlay: fractal-noise grain, multiply, very low opacity, finite iteration count — breaks up banding in the light gradients

hand_authored: inhale/exhale ink motif (point + hairline gather, ripple + ring on the hit)
the P grows out of the ink point (scale from the head's centre), the foot steps in
Bildmarke glides to its lockup slot; PHYSIOFIT rises letter by letter out of a baseline mask
custom synthesized sonic logo, composed frame-accurately to the beats

cues.what: inhale — reverse-reverb swell of the hit chord + rising air
hit — sub drop + felt transient + Dmaj9 bloom pad + glass bell
step — soft felt knock as the P's foot steps in
air whoosh following the mark's velocity (pans left)
soft harp gliss, one note per letter as PHYSIOFIT rises, panned to each letter
sparkle following the satin glint L→R
exhale — downward air, tail decays to silence at 4.0

brief: Out of clean paper, a single ink point breathes in: a hairline stretches across the centre, then gathers back into the point while the sound swells as a reversed echo of the chord to come. On the downbeat at 0.8s the point becomes the head of the Physiofit P — it grows out of the point with a soft ink ripple and one ring, a warm sub and a Dmaj9 chord with a glass bell — and the foot steps in underneath with a soft felt knock. The Bildmarke glides into its lockup slot, then PHYSIOFIT rises letter by letter out of a baseline mask to a quiet harp gliss. A chime settles the lockup, one satin glint passes across it, then everything exhales — blur, fade, a downward breath — back to paper at 3.7s, leaving a clean reverb tail to 4.0s. Dominant motif: breath — inhale, bloom, exhale.
